subject: Legistar roll-call person rows on meeting-outcomes materialization

after_fixture.basis: Identified fixture rows (both PersonId and VotePersonId shapes) retain official:{person_id} and votes_on edges. Characterization: node --test test/official_entity_family.test.mjs test/legistar_client.test.mjs test/contract/meeting_outcomes.test.mjs.

after_live_audit_2026_08_02.sample: event 22526: 49/49 vote rows retained person identity across 7/7 items with votes; sample first person Christopher Marte
after_live_audit_2026_08_02.basis: Live authenticated Votes fetch + summarizePersonVotes after VotePerson* field mapping. Production meeting-outcomes KV still needs re-materialization (daily cron or admin refresh) before public by_person is non-empty.

reader_facing_empty_register: meeting_outcomes_no_person_votes_html (class a not_yet_ingested) only when tallies present and by_person empty after mapping; vote_identity=tally_only when publisher omits person fields
remaining_gap: Public meeting-outcomes KV must re-materialize with the fixed mapper before product surfaces show by_person. People domain leaves not_yet_ingested until those retained rows flow into entity-intelligence observations.
